# 工质性质与热力参数

_Working Fluids & Thermodynamic Properties_

干空气、燃烧产物及含水工质的性质，是性能计算的输入条件。读模型时应检查工质组成、温度范围和物性假设，并保持静态量、总量与单位的定义一致。

_Dry air, combustion products and water-containing mixtures provide property inputs to performance calculations. Check composition, temperature range and property assumptions, and use consistent definitions for static quantities, total quantities and units._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 区分气体常数、定压比热与比热比，记录所用物性模型及温度范围。

_Distinguish the gas constant, constant-pressure specific heat and specific-heat ratio, recording the property model and temperature range._

- 解释总温、总压与静温、静压的区别，并沿站位保留一致的符号约定。

_Explain total versus static temperature and pressure, keeping station notation consistent._

- 比较不同计算结果前，先核对燃料组成、燃空比和物性处理方法。

_Check fuel composition, fuel–air ratio and property treatment before comparing calculations._

参考书主题对应：第 3 章。下文是本站导读，章节关联用于定位原书。
